candidates.explanation: When no user is found by socialId but one exists with the same email, the code overwrites provider and socialId on that existing account for any non-inactive status. An active, confirmed email/password account therefore gets provider='google' and a new socialId, so the email login then says to use provider google. The check only excludes inactive accounts; it should not link/overwrite an active account whose provider is 'email' (or should link without changing the provider).

fix.description: In the `else if (userByEmail)` branch, do not overwrite provider/socialId of an existing active account registered with another provider (e.g. email). Either reject with an error such as email 'emailAlreadyExists'/needLoginViaProvider, or only link when the account is not an active password account. Do not call usersService.update with provider/socialId changed for active email-provider users.
